range: Legacy failure, generated failure/replay and two distinct controls; shared harness and fixtures, not independent holdouts.
limits: In-process registry/JSON/runtime oracle, not a new HTTP/browser campaign.
No latency, full PG syntax, arbitrary row cardinality, or deployment claim.
R6 automatic failure reporting is a future evidence-system requirement, not something these saved reports already implement.
abstraction: Evidence-work process; application execution is an observed check result, not simulated database behavior.
event_wording: Action granularity and short names are analyst choices; observations retain source references.
state_semantics: Guards are AND clauses, with OR across clauses. A replay event has enabled, occurring and accomplished-but-not-depleted phases. Phase expansion is a modeling convention, not measured timing. Repeated checks are new occurrences; evidence is reusable, not consumed by being read.

commutation_checks.basis: D-R3; provisional source-derived independence, not a real-world scheduling experiment
